policy: Keep original speech, marker positions and templates. Allocate the additional PCM energy of the +0.694 dB control in sixths among three marker windows. Exclude clipping and require both dry readers to reproduce HEYNIX. Rank by timely native fixed hits on 48 training RIRs, 24 separate training music tracks, 2 excerpts per RIR and three SNRs. Tie break nearest equal allocation, then lexicographic. No receiver adaptation.
